The headline claim is that it has served 300+ mid market and enterprise B2B tech firms and that clients average 41% more high intent demo requests; the record ties that average to no named client.

The sold mix leads with B2B & ABM at score 3: the site title brands it a B2B demand generation agency. The core lines at score 2 are Data & Measurement (GTM analysis, reporting and funnel modeling, with the Vena and Zappi stories tagged with them), Paid Search (the myCOI story credits paid search with 50% more qualified demos) and Paid Social (in house ad creative, performance marketers, LinkedIn thought leader ads). CRO scores 1 with no evidence note; SEO, content and digital PR, email and CRM, web, AI search and AI automation all score 0. The proprietary layer is the Brand. Demand. Expand. operating system, the Revenue Performance Assessment and HIRO, a qualified pipeline metric.

openings:
The strongest opening is say and do on its own spend. Refine Labs sells paid social and measurement, runs 24+ LinkedIn ads and 2 Google ads, and the record detects no social ad pixel on its site, only GTM. A rival that shows its own LinkedIn spend traced to pipeline is likely, moderate confidence, to win the measurement credibility test with Series B+ buyers. Falsifier: a LinkedIn or Meta pixel found on refinelabs.com in the next compile.

The softest accounts are Clari, dotCMS and Loxo: outcome titles, no described work, so a rival can ask what was bought, low confidence on which need to lead with. myCOI also sits on the book of smarketer, a roughly even chance it is already shopping. Bonterra, its one lead generation row, sits outside the pipeline core.
